label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common), habituating over repeated rewarded a1/S1 trials and late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by a common transition (99.9% of mass; never on S2, almost never on a1->S2 rare or a2->S1 rare). It never fires at D1 or GO. Activity dies out late in the episode: none after trial ~85, and the rate falls steadily from trial 0 to 80. Magnitude is largest on the first a1->S1c after something else (an unrewarded trial, a rare trial, or an a2 choice). It then decays over consecutive rewarded a1->S1c trials (e.g. 0.99, 0.64, 0.42, 0.28) and goes silent after long rewarded runs, which is the main source of false positives. Requiring that the previous two trials were not both rewarded a1->S1 raises F1 only slightly (0.795 vs 0.786 on dev), so the simpler predicate is recorded. It uses only observed variables: action and state are both known at D2. Dev scores: P 0.65, R 0.99, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.998. Only partially explained, because a novelty/habituation signal sets whether it fires within the a1->S1c set.
